hero.text: Tasks, calendar, your circle, work tools — all in one account. Like a sketchbook that holds your whole life.

circle.title: Circle
circle.text: Organize your contacts by role: family, friends, colleagues. Assign tasks and share your calendar.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.text: Set tasks for yourself and for the people close to you. Subtasks, deadlines, priorities, coins for getting them done.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.text: Every event and task in one place. Google Calendar sync, sharing with the family.

cta.title: One account — for everything
cta.text: Husband, friend, employee, administrator — every role in one place. No extra accounts and passwords.
